newsitem.title: FRANCE: Publicis said more profitable after accord.
newsitem.headline: Publicis said more profitable after accord.

text.p: Maurice Levy, chairman of Publicis, said on Thursday that his company would be more profitable following its accord with its former U.S. ally, True North .

"Publicis becomes stronger in Europe, and the accord gives us the means to speed up our worldwide development, and brings us better funcionality, better synergies, better profitability and a profit potential which will grow," he told a news conference.
